laws.rule: Great Walk huts must be booked in advance on DOC's booking system; international visitors pay higher summer rates (October to April) and DOC staff run random checks at huts. Milford Track: international adult NZD 152 a hut night in summer (about A$122, RBA rate of 30 October 2026); independent walkers need three consecutive nights. Kepler Track: NZD 132. Rakiura Track: NZD 66.

layers.process: Milford Track (Fiordland National Park): in the Great Walks season (1 November 2026 to 30 April 2027, last departure 28 April 2027) huts and transport must be booked. The track can only be walked in one direction, over 3 nights and 4 days. Camping is not permitted on the track. Outside the season (1 May to 31 October) facilities are greatly reduced and DOC says only fit, experienced people with alpine, river-crossing and navigation skills should attempt it. No dogs.
